description:
RaidTrainExpress connects your RTE raid train schedule to ChatGPT, so you can check what's coming up and set up your next event without leaving the conversation.

Ask what's on your calendar and get your trains, challenges, your own slot times, and any to-dos that are due — all in your timezone, with links back to each event. Ask about a specific train and you get what matters for your role: organizers see how much of the lineup is filled and who still has to-dos outstanding; participants see their slot and what they need to do before it.

Not sure how something works? Ask, and you get an answer drawn from the actual Raid Train Express help docs, with a link to the full article — no guessing about features.

When you're ready to run something new, it walks you through creating a train or a challenge one question at a time, checks your invite list against your contacts, and shows you the full plan before anything is created. Nothing goes live until you confirm.

Read-only unless you say otherwise, and it only ever sees what your own account can see. Connect and disconnect any time from your account settings.

defaultPrompt: What's on my raid train schedule this week?
Help me set up a raid train for Friday night with 8 sellers.
